frame: canonical tree frame: origin = bottom-centre of trunk base, +x right, +y up (front view), polygons are the bottom (glue) face outline

chamfer_mm.rule: 0.15 mm on stems 1.0 mm wide, rising linearly to 0.3 mm from 1.6 mm wide features up (45 deg)

outline_full.z_mm: z >= 0.3 (walls are vertical above the chamfer)

notes: polygons = exact outline of the z = 0 face of tree.stl (the glue face, inset by the bed chamfer: 0.15 to 0.3 mm). outline_full = exact outline of the vertical walls above the chamfer, i.e. the visible silhouette and the largest section of the tree. Size the pocket from outline_full + clearance so the tree drops in to the full pocket depth (a pocket sized from the glue face would only let the chamfer seat on its rim). trunk_base x_left/x_right = ends of the straight trunk-bottom edge at y = 0 (the lowest line of the solid); the glue face starts at glue_face_y_min. Exteriors CCW, holes CW.
